judge_anchors: The event window is 2021-03-26 through 2021-04-15, giving 21 inclusive days.
The report says Nepal received just a quarter of normal January-April rainfall, so the fraction is 0.250 and the deficit is 0.750.
The report gives roughly 41,000 VIIRS hotspots, so hotspot_norm is 0.82.
The three required indices are 86.05, 100.00, and 89.20 after rounding to two decimals.
The narrative supports smoke, health, school, evacuation, fatality, and flight disruption signals, but not direct facility damage.

notes: Off-event daily weather, dNBR, embedding, WorldPop, and OSM receptor products are not used in this ground truth.
The process indices are computed from declared event anchor metadata and NASA Earth Observatory report text.

criteria.description: Reports 21 inclusive days and the report-supported rainfall fraction 0.250.
criteria.name: Event window and rainfall fraction
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the correct window or severe rainfall-deficit reading with one missing numeric value.

criteria.description: Recomputes 86.05 from rainfall deficit, hot/windy text, rugged terrain, and hotspot normalization.
criteria.name: Fire-weather formula
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for the correct formula with one missing text signal or normalization.

criteria.description: Recomputes 100.00 from four smoke signals, four disruption signals, and the eastward transport path.
criteria.name: Smoke-disruption formula
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct signal family and 1 point for the correct formula.

criteria.description: Recomputes 89.20 from hotspot_norm 0.82, second-rank hotspot status, and uncontrolled forest-burn text.
criteria.name: Burn-activity formula
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using the right burn-activity inputs with one arithmetic error.

criteria.description: Keeps direct_damage_reported false because smoke disruption and fatalities are not direct property/building/facility damage statements.
criteria.name: Explicit damage flag
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for cautioning against a damage claim while omitting the required boolean.

criteria.description: Uses the requested fields, rounds numeric values correctly, and sets formula_check to pass.
criteria.name: Compact reproducible JSON
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for correct values in a less compact format.

criteria.description: Bases the indices on report-supported values and does not use off-event weather, dNBR, embedding, or receptor counts as physical-process substitutes.
criteria.name: Source discipline
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the answer mostly uses report values but adds one unsupported physical-product claim.
